outcome: Near miss cases of bleeding during and after caesarean section (BDACS)
cohort: Women undergoing caesarean section at 13 public hospitals in greater Johannesburg, South Africa
finding: This study found that previous caesarean section, anaemia, and pregnancy-induced hypertension were major risk factors for near miss BDACS, and that structural and process deficiencies in the healthcare system, including ambulance delays and lack of facilities, contributed to these near miss cases.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was identified as a dominant risk factor for near miss BDACS.
